messages:
incident-bot: Pager: model-serving-high-error-rate for service=redwood-text-inference region=us-west-2. Severity=high. Affected route=/v1/generate, success_rate=72% (threshold 99%). Initial spike detected at 2026-03-15T09:15:00Z
Amber (oncall): Acked. oncall here. grabbing context and paging SRE/ENG.
Jon (sre): Jumping in. Any runbook link?
Amber (oncall): runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/model-rollouts. Metrics: error rate + latency up, canary pool showing 40% of requests failing.
Harold (eng): looking at canary logs now. I see lots of tokenizer errors and mismatch traces. Pasting tail of canary agent logs:
```
Error: UnknownTokenError token id 50256 not in vocab (tokenizer=vocab_v1)
2026-03-15T09:16:14Z model_id=rw-model-v13 weight-shard=shard-3 quant=8bit
Warning: embedding dimension mismatch expected=1024 got=768
```
Harold (eng): That UnknownTokenError suggests a vocab mismatch between the served weights and the tokenizer metadata.
Rita (ops): Can we flip traffic off the canary? Is there a kill flag for rollouts?
Harold (eng): Yes, there's feature flag 'rollout:rw-model-v13'. I recommend kill now and route to rw-model-v12 fallback. Also suspect weight bundle index pointing to wrong S3 prefix.
Amber (oncall): @Rita can you toggle the kill? We need immediate mitigation.
Rita (ops): doing it now via Console -> Models -> rw-models -> rw-model-v13 -> Disable rollout
deploy-bot: Feature flag 'rollout:rw-model-v13' set to off by Rita (ops) at 2026-03-15T09:17:30Z. Routing update in progress.
deploy-bot: Routing table change completed. All traffic rebalanced to rw-model-v12 (stable).
Miguel (support): Seeing elevated error reports from 3 enterprise customers (acct:cobalt, acct:lyra, acct:atlas). CS notified. Sending customers a short note now.
Elaine (product): Any customer-facing impact estimate? Rough numbers?
Jon (sre): From metrics: errors went from ~0.5% baseline to 28% during 09:15-09:17 window on canary nodes. Estimated impacted requests ~12k, tail latency increased for 5%.
Harold (eng): Root cause preliminary: when we expanded canary yesterday, CI wrote model metadata with tokenizer_version='vocab_v1' but weights are compiled against 'vocab_v2' (different BPE token ids). Also one weight-shard upload pointed at legacy prefix which triggered mixed-version serving on the canary pool.
Harold (eng): Quick artifact check:
```
# model-manifest snippet
model: rw-model-v13
tokenizer: vocab_v2
manifest_tokenizer: vocab_v1  # mismatch introduced by ci hook
```
Harold (eng): That explains UnknownTokenError and embed dim mismatch for some requests (old quantized shard replaced inconsistent shard).
Amber (oncall): Good mitigation. Are any other canaries still rolling?
Harold (eng): No, kill-flag stopped the automatic canary expansion. Canary pool drained in ~40s. Stable pool unaffected.
Rita (ops): Confirmed routing fully on v12. I've also pinned autoscaler to avoid any immediate rollouts.
Jon (sre): Recommend a rollback of the v13 artifact from the registry to prevent accidental re-deployment while we investigate.
Harold (eng): Agree. I'm initiating an artifact block+rollback. Command: `deployctl block-artifact rw-model-v13 && deployctl rollback-model rw-model-v13 --to rw-model-v12`
deploy-bot: deployctl: block-artifact rw-model-v13 accepted. rollback job queued.
deploy-bot: rollback job completed at 2026-03-15T09:20:45Z. All clusters running rw-model-v12.
Miguel (support): Customers acknowledged. One asked for ETA for fix. I told them we rolled back and will follow up with RCA within 48h.
Elaine (product): Please include mitigation steps in the note. Also worth a quick audit of CI token/version hooks.
Harold (eng): Post-rollback log snippet:
```
INFO: rollout rw-model-v13 disabled
INFO: stable rw-model-v12 serving resumed
Metric check: success_rate back to 99.6% by 09:21:30Z
```
Amber (oncall): Monitoring metrics on dashboards. No elevated alerts in last 10m.
Jon (sre): Next steps: 1) preserve all canary artifacts/metadata for forensic; 2) run a CI gate to ensure tokenizer manifest and weight manifest agree; 3) blacklist v13 until revalidation; 4) customer comms. I'll open incident ticket and assign follow-ups.
Harold (eng): Adding: we should add a unit test in model-onboarding to verify tokenizer vocab ids versus weights embed size, and add an automated pre-rollout checksum that compares tokenizer checksum and weight build metadata.
Rita (ops): Ops note: we need a quick UI affordance to view manifest diff during canary stage. Filing ops-ui ticket.
Amber (oncall): I'm handing off to Jon for postmortem and Harold for engineering fix. If anything changes ping here.
Jon (sre): I'll run a short blameless RCA. Drafting incident ticket INC-2026-0315-01 and assigning Harold, Rita, CI team.
Harold (eng): Temporary mitigation checklist I ran:
- disabled rollout flag
- blocked artifact in registry
- rolled back clusters to v12
- validated token maps on stable nodes
- saved canary shard manifests to s3://incidents/2065432100/
Amber (oncall): Thanks. closing pager. I'll leave thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
Customer Ops: Thanks for the quick rollback. Please share the customer-facing RCA when available.
Harold (eng): Will prepare root cause summary and proposed fixes. ETA for PRs ~48h.
Jon (sre): Incident severity: Sev2. No data exfiltration, customer API errors observed and mitigated. Postmortem meeting scheduled 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.
Amber (oncall): End of thread for live mitigation. Follow-up actions tracked in INC-2026-0315-01.
